about: How a forge game's sound ids become this library's sounds (wave 2, track U; tools/sound-wire.mjs reads it, create calls that). The core plays sounds by the ids its tables name (research/gf-forge/kit/tables); sounds.json is the library's own list. alias: a table id that is a library sound under another name. aliasByKind: the same, chosen by the kind of the weapons that name the id. own: sounds the library has no entry for, made from its files (no new recording: a composition, a slice or a pitch). always, withWaves, withCards: library sounds the kit itself plays (gf/forge/sound.js), added whatever the tables name. An id with no alias, no own entry and no library entry keeps its gf-audio preset; the tool lists those.

round-end.label: The round is lost or over (a low knell)

elite-ignite.label: A player is set alight (wave 7: a burning elite's blow)

trimWhy: dB taken off a library sound in a game (never added: research/audio/GUIDE.md rule 4). player-death: alone through the sfx bus its loudest 400 ms was 9.9 LU over the median of a fight's sounds and 2.3 over the next loudest (tools/listen.mjs, 2026-10-10); -3 dB puts it beside the hurt sound.
